hypotheses.reason: Far versus near context changes period eligibility; not proof of a quantitative cutoff.
Poor coordination still permits four-tenths defense; correction follows the target index despite other indices.
Trigger OR and original-participant correction AND coexist in different phases; do not claim same-input contradiction.
Distance matters, but size/easy disappearance is discussed and Jan6 wording is ambiguous; no matched actual-event pair isolates the effect.
Jan6 does not establish a formed ignored structure; selected future structure still calls for action even if a false retreat is expected.
Author explicitly distinguishes the heuristic high from action/structure.
Counter-direction horizon and expected safe window do not state automatic expiry; no actual expiry pair collected.
Conditional bottom protection and actual trend defense belong to different cases; ambiguous bottom instrument prevents a same-instrument conflict contrast.
